info.title: Ichimoku Cloud Signal
info.description: Real-time crypto trading signals for agents on live market data (Binance.US, Kraken, Gate, MEXC): the Ichimoku Cloud signal, a confluence signal of six indicators, price levels with a long/short plan, and a market scan of 148 top-200 coins. Pay-per-call via x402.
info.x-guidance: Use this when a trading agent needs a quick Ichimoku Cloud read (tenkan/kijun cross, cloud position, bullish/bearish/neutral signal) for one pair before deciding to act. It returns the raw indicator values, not a trade recommendation, and it is not a full OHLCV history feed. For a broader read, /signals/{pair} ($0.15) returns Ichimoku, RSI, MACD, EMA 50/200, Bollinger Bands and volume, each with a vote, plus a combined signal and confidence. For where to act, /levels/{pair} ($0.05) returns support and resistance, ATR, pivots, Fibonacci and Ichimoku levels, plus a long and a short plan with stop, two targets and risk/reward (levels, not advice). To find what is moving, /scan ($0.10) returns the Ichimoku signal for 148 top-200 coins in one call, strongest bullish first, with market breadth. To find what to trade, /setups ($0.50) returns, for the same coins, the six-indicator confluence signal plus a trade plan in that direction (entry, stop, two targets, risk/reward), ranked best first, with long/short, minimum risk/reward, top-N and liquid_top filters (levels, not advice); thinly traded coins rank lower because spread and slippage eat their edge.

get.description: Which crypto coins have a trade setup right now? For 148 top-200 coins: the six-indicator confluence signal (Ichimoku, RSI, MACD, EMA 50/200, Bollinger, OBV) plus a trade plan in that direction from /levels (entry, stop, two targets, risk/reward). Neutral coins and plans under the minimum risk/reward are left out. Ranked by signal strength x risk/reward (up to 3), lower for above-median volatility (ATR%) and for support/resistance right after the entry. volume_24h_usd is on the listed exchange only. Levels from price history, not trade advice.
